description: This is a Java test source file that contains resilience tests for the HiveMQ MQTT3 client actor in the Ditto project. It verifies reconnect behavior and redelivery handling during MQTT connectivity scenarios, specifically testing that the client restarts appropriately when reconnect-for-redelivery is triggered under certain configurations.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientActorReconnectForRedeliveryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying reconnect and redelivery behavior of HiveMQ MQTT3 client actor, with emphasis on reconnect-for-redelivery trigger and client restart logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Akka actor system, creates connection objects, and sets up mock MQTT client factory before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: reconnectForRedeliveryTriggersConsumerClientRestartWhenSeparatePublisherClientEnabled
methods.description: Main test method that verifies triggering reconnect-for-redelivery causes the MQTT client actor to restart its subscriber client, especially when separate publisher client is enabled.
